Traveler.bonusSkirk2.label: Elemental Mastery bonus
Traveler.bonusSkirk2.reason: Adds Elemental Mastery only, which none of the counted hits use.

c1SkillActive.label: Constellation 1 while the Skill is active
c1SkillActive.reason: A Constellation 1 bonus whose conditions the planner cannot check, so it is left for the player to switch on.

c4AfterBurst.label: Constellation 4 after the Burst
c4AfterBurst.reason: A Constellation 4 bonus whose conditions the planner cannot check, so it is left for the player to switch on.

c6InNs.label: Constellation 6 in Nightsoul's Blessing
c6InNs.reason: A Constellation 6 bonus that reaches only Normal, Charged and Plunging Attacks during Nightsoul's Blessing. It makes them Pyro, counted when it is switched on here, and it was checked once with it on against Genshin Optimizer.

c1Ns.label: Constellation 1 in Nightsoul's Blessing
c1Ns.reason: An extra DMG bonus of Constellation 1 for the active character in Nightsoul's Blessing, on top of the one while the Skill is active. The planner cannot check its conditions, so it is left for the player to switch on. It was checked once with it and its other switch on against Genshin Optimizer and agreed; no case commits it.

Traveler.lockedPassive.label: The Traveler's locked passive
Traveler.lockedPassive.reason: A passive of the Traveler's whose bonuses depend on the party's elements; the planner cannot tell whether it is on, so it is left for the player to switch on. It was checked once with it and its other switches on against Genshin Optimizer and agreed; no case commits it.
